note: Both sets capture the main equipment ratings (2.8 kW inverter, 50A/2P main breaker, 60A and 200A NFDS, 120/240V sub-panel) with supporting quotes, and both make the same error of binding '3W' to 'phase' when the note reads 1-phase, 3-wire. Set A additionally extracts the 200A NFDS enclosure type (NEMA 3R) with a matching quote and gives the DC NFDS enclosure claim its correct quote. Set B omits the 200A NFDS enclosure fact and attaches the 200A NFDS quote to the DC NFDS enclosure claim, so its quote does not support that claim.
remarks: Both sets misread '1, 3W' on the SUB-PANEL PV note: 1 is the phase count and 3W the wire count, so the 'phase = 3 W' claim in both is misbound. The wiring schedule quotes are truncated (e.g. '150 AL: 3#4/0' drops the ground/conduit details), and the NEC 690.42 exception note (conductor-to-ground bond by the GFCI device) is not extracted by either set.
